question: In which country can I find the circuit with the highest altitude?
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT country AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY alt DESC) AS __r FROM circuits) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT country FROM circuits ORDER BY alt DESC LIMIT 1

b.request: Return the country (or countries, if several circuits tie for the maximum altitude) of every circuit whose altitude (alt) equals the maximum altitude across all circuits
b.sql: SELECT country FROM circuits WHERE alt = (SELECT MAX(alt) FROM circuits)

d.request: In which country can I find the circuit (or circuits) with the highest altitude, where highest altitude refers to max(alt), and if several circuits tie for that maximum altitude, return the country for all of them?
d.sql: SELECT country FROM circuits WHERE alt = (SELECT MAX(alt) FROM circuits)
